# Mixtape Maker

> Free web app to build cassette mixtapes with Spotify search and design print-ready J-cards for cassette cases.

## Features

- Mixtape editor with Side A / Side B tracklists
- Spotify track search
- Cassette length calculator (C-46, C-60, C-90)
- Drag-and-drop track ordering
- J-card designer with print-ready PDF export
- Optional cloud save (sign in required)

## URLs

- https://mixtape-maker.com — Homepage and product overview
- https://mixtape-maker.com/mixtape — Mixtape editor
- https://mixtape-maker.com/library — Saved mixtapes and J-cards library
- https://mixtape-maker.com/cards/designer — J-card designer
